test_title: PYST 6: SSC CPO - English (Held On: 04 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

We have being / arranged the stay / for the guests at / a hillside resort.
solution:
The correct answer is Option 2 i.e. **'We have being'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The use of **being **in this context is both grammatically and contextually wrong.
 
• The **correct **phrase should be ** "have arranged" **for the perfect tense.
 
• "Been" will be wrong contextually. As the subject 'we' itself completes the action.

Therefore, the corrected sentence is- ***We have** arranged the stay for the guests at a hillside resort. *

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1)** "a hillside resort": **This option is grammatically correct and specifies the location of the arrangement.
 
• Option 3) **"arranged the stay": **This segment is correct and indicates the action that has been completed.
 
• Option 4) **"for the guests at": **Correctly prepositions the phrase, indicating who the arrangements are for and their location.
